title: graphic-eq
description: `graphic-eq` is a stereo seven-band equalizer with adjustable bands at 100, 200, 400, 800, 1600, 3200, and 6400 Hz. It accepts left and right audio inputs and provides corresponding stereo outputs; global Q and output level controls are available, along with attenuated LOW, MID, and HIGH CV inputs for controlling grouped bandpass filters.
